source.name: ILO Working Paper 140: Generative AI and Jobs: A Refined Global Index of Occupational Exposure (Annex Table A1)
source.authors: Gmyrek, P.; Berg, J.; Kamiński, K.; Konopczyński, F.; Ładna, A.; Nafradi, B.; Rosłaniec, K.; Troszyński, M.
source.file: Generative AI and Jobs: A Refined Global Index of Occupational Exposure.pdf
source.measure: Mean and SD of task-level generative-AI exposure scores (0-1) per ISCO-08 4-digit occupation
source.coverage: Occupations listed in Table A1 only. Exposure means tasks could be changed by GenAI; it is not a forecast of job loss.
source.gradientRule: gradient = printedGradient (label read from Table A1) or, if unreadable, ruleGradient = the paper's threshold rule applied to the 2-decimal mean and SD (cross-check only)
